notes: Change the default admin password immediately after the first login. Umami creates admin/umami when initializing a new database; existing passwords are preserved.
Umami v3 uses the exact GHCR tag 3.4.0, not the older postgresql-v-prefixed tag scheme. Its official startup runs database migrations before starting the application.
PostgreSQL 16.15 is supported by Umami's documented PostgreSQL 12.14 minimum. The database has no published port and persists in its own named volume.
Two-factor authentication is not configured: Umami requires a separate persistent 64-character hexadecimal TWO_FACTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY before users can enable 2FA.
The 512m application floor is provisional until measured on both supported Ubuntu releases; tested image lists remain empty until live verification.
